source_row.rationale: Barcode medication administration (BCMA) technology verifies key elements of safe medication administration (such as the correct patient and medication) by scanning barcodes on the client's ID band and the medication packaging, cross-referencing against the electronic medication administration record, helping reduce the risk of medication errors, though it does not replace nursing clinical judgment.
source_row.source_detail: BCMA verifies patient/medication information against the electronic medication record and is used to reduce administration errors; accessed 2026-08-14.
